prerequisites: the full M2-VERIFY unit is complete after the exact eight-product Sentinel acquisition and verification route is reconciled
the corrected runner guard remains exact and passing before catalogue or token access
the original failed receipt and both external events remain unchanged
the current CDSE legal section, structured modification date, linked legal notice, exact orbit catalogue identity, size, checksums, online state, paths, collisions, and storage are revalidated
a fresh access token is obtained only through the existing owner-controlled protected credential reference
transfer_controls: request the complete exact AUX_RESORB file from byte zero without Range or resume semantics
use a distinct exclusive staging path and preserve every event
require exact catalogue length, provider MD5, provider BLAKE3, and local SHA-256 before no-replace promotion
verify safe XML, mission and filename identity, ordered finite OSVs, exact validity coverage, and exact scene binding
post_success_release: reconcile M2-ORB-001 only through its separately approved successful recovery identity
continue only M2-ORB-002 through M2-ORB-004 under the original approval as each prerequisite passes
stop and preserve evidence on any later transfer or verification failure
proposed_recovery.failure_policy: Any recovery failure is terminal for the new recovery identity and requires another explicit review; no automatic retry is authorized.

approval_would_authorize: implement and validate the exact separate M2-ORB-001 recovery control described here
after M2-VERIFY is complete, perform one fresh full transfer of only the exact approved M2-ORB-001 AUX_RESORB file through a new exclusive attempt path
verify and promote only that file if every authority, dependency, rights, identity, size, checksum, XML, OSV, validity, path, and custody control passes
after a passing recovery, continue only the three still-unattempted orbit files under the original approval and their existing prerequisites
approval_would_not_authorize: run recovery before M2-VERIFY is complete
delete, rewrite, hide, or reuse the retained failed attempt or events
use a synthetic token value, expose any owner credential, accept terms, change an account or MFA, or incur cost
change an orbit provider UUID, filename, type, validity interval, scene binding, destination, or approved manifest
perform repeated retry, substitute AUX_POEORB, add orbit files, apply orbit data, process radar pixels, admit scientific evidence, or publish a scientific result
limitations: The rejected provider response does not test the exact AUX_RESORB payload because the failed attempt used a nonsecret test literal and received zero bytes.
A future owner-credential transfer may still fail and has no automatic second retry.
Even a passing orbit file would not establish corrected imagery, geolocation accuracy, pixel usability, change, attribution, or scientific fitness.
This proposal creates no authority until the exact review bundle is approved and reconciled.
